Use case: identity-preserve. Production sprite sheet for Echoes of Dante, Organic Sci-Fi R3 painterly 2D isometric action RPG. Reference1 defines the PIONEER identity: SAME recognizable brown-haired person, face/skin/build, charcoal short-sleeve shirt, olive field trousers, brown boots and leather field belt/gloves. Reference2 ONLY defines profession instrument; do NOT copy its silver hair, blue/orange clothes, face or body. Original art compatible with our existing environment.
Create EXACTLY 8 columns x 6 rows =48 SEPARATE COMPLETE HUMAN FIGURES, equal regular cells, landscape4:3 sheet around1536x1152, transparent alpha. NO floor, shadows, text, gridlines, loose fragments or limbs. Keep all figures/instruments entirely inside cells with generous margins. Same camera, scale, proportions and lighting in every cell. No collage or separable heads/arms.
Every row columns face: S/front, SE/right-front, E/right-profile, NE/right-back, N/back, NW/left-back, W/left-profile, SW/left-front.
Rows: 1 idle ready; 2 grounded WALK left-foot contact/rightleg trailing; 3 passing right knee past planted left sole; 4 right-foot contact/leftleg trailing; 5 passing left knee past planted right sole; 6 compact profession action aimed in that column's facing. Four REAL different walking phases, natural low stride, no running/high knees or copied idle. Both feet visible and same baseline. No enlarged attack pose, giant leap or changed torso size. Top-left soft light, textured fabric/leather/metal, muted warm skin and clear volumes readable at gameplay size. No microdetail, white edges, baked trails or particles. REMOVE EVERY original energy saber/blade from the character.

HUNTER: a compact TWO-HANDED plasma carbine, integrated gunmetal receiver/barrel and stock, dark textured grip, a small teal/cyan muzzle aperture at the barrel tip. Physically defined thick weapon, sensible grip: dominant hand grips trigger, support hand on fore-end, butt near shoulder during action. Idle/walk low ready with muzzle forward/down; action aims ahead of facing at shoulder/chest height. Rifle NOT watergun, medieval bow, pistol, staff or saber. No beam/shot/flame painted in the sprite. Maintain the pioneer's own charcoal/olive clothing.
FEMALE PIONEIRA, match reference1's short tousled brown hair and female athletic build, original face; no helmet.
